title: The Challenge of Identifying the Origin of Black-Box Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2503.04332v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The tremendous commercial potential of large language models (LLMs) has heightened concerns over their unauthorized use. To address this, we focus on the task of identifying the origin of black-box LLMs. We further propose PlugAE, an effective and efficient identification method that proactively leverages LLM-specific adversarial embeddings and allows users to customize copyright tokens on a targeted query set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PlugAE outperforms both state-of-the-art model watermarking and fingerprinting methods in accuracy and robustness. We further analyze its stealthiness and reliability from three complementary perspectives and conduct ablation studies under various configurations, confirming its practicality for real-world misuse detection.

translated_title: 识别黑盒大语言模型来源的挑战
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）巨大的商业潜力加剧了人们对其未经授权使用的担忧。为解决这一问题，我们专注于识别黑盒大语言模型来源的任务。我们进一步提出了PlugAE，一种高效且有效的识别方法，该方法主动利用大语言模型特有的对抗性嵌入，并允许用户在目标查询集上自定义版权标记。大量实验表明，PlugAE在准确性和鲁棒性方面均优于当前最先进的模型水印和模型指纹方法。我们从三个互补的角度进一步分析了其隐蔽性和可靠性，并在多种配置下进行了消融研究，证实了其在真实世界滥用检测中的实用性。
tldr: 提出PlugAE方法，通过主动利用大语言模型特有的对抗性嵌入和可自定义的版权标记，在准确性和鲁棒性上超越现有水印与指纹方法，有效识别黑盒大语言模型的来源。
en_tdlr: PlugAE is proposed as an effective and efficient method to identify the origin of black-box LLMs by proactively leveraging LLM-specific adversarial embeddings and customizable copyright tokens, outperforming state-of-the-art watermarking and fingerprinting methods in accuracy and robustness.
